name: model_search
description: Find real, open-licensed 3D models by name (a jet engine, a T-rex skull, a chair) to show in the room. Use it when the person asks to see a real object that isn't one of the artifact templates and that plain shapes wouldn't do justice. Needs the hub or Albie's cloud; if it says neither is reachable, tell the person that and offer to build it from shapes instead. Returns a few hits: pick, id, name, author, licence (CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA only), triangles, size_mb. Say the top two or three by name and author and ask which one. Never import one the person didn't pick.

query.description: what to look for, in a few plain words, like 'jet engine'

name: model_import
description: Bring ONE model the person chose from the last model_search into the room: it is downloaded, checked (licence, size, triangles), saved as an artifact and opened, scaled to fit. Give the hit's id, or pick (its number in the list). One model per call, only after the person picked it. Then say its name, who made it and its licence; the credit is also on its panel. If it is refused (too heavy, licence, not reachable), say why in plain words and offer another hit.

id.description: the chosen hit's id, exactly as model_search gave it

pick.description: or the chosen hit's number in the last search, from 1
